![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

According to the general rules, static HTML tables with highly variable content lengths should use `table-layout: auto` to ensure readable variable-width columns. Please update the CSS to use `table-layout: auto` instead of `table-layout: fixed`.

```suggestion
    table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:auto; }
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Use `table-layout: auto` for static HTML tables with highly variable content lengths to ensure readable variable-width columns, and enforce this layout choice with a validator check.
</details>
Fixed in commit d33ba490b. The static console now uses `table-layout:auto`, and the readback verification includes a `Static HTML tables use variable-width layout` check.
